description: IRS Schedule E (Form 1040), Supplemental Income and Loss, page 1: Part I, income or loss from rental real estate and royalties

tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form header, e.g. 2020

taxpayer.description: The filer named at the top of the schedule

name.description: Name(s) shown on return, as printed

ssn.description: Your social security number, as printed, including any masking characters

made_payments_requiring_1099.description: Line A: true if Yes is checked, false if No is checked, null if neither

filed_required_1099s.description: Line B: true if Yes is checked, false if No is checked, null if neither

properties.description: Part I properties, one per filled column A to C

items.description: One rental real estate or royalty property: one lettered column (A, B or C) of Part I. Include only columns with any entry.

column.description: The property column letter on the form: A, B or C

physical_address.description: Line 1a: physical address of the property (street, city, state, ZIP), as printed

property_type_code.description: Line 1b: the type-of-property code entered, 1 to 8 (1 single family residence, 2 multi-family residence, 3 vacation/short-term rental, 4 commercial, 5 land, 6 royalties, 7 self-rental, 8 other)

qualified_joint_venture.description: Line 2: true if the QJV box is checked, false if it is unchecked

rents_received.description: Line 3: rents received. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

royalties_received.description: Line 4: royalties received. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

expenses.description: Expense lines 5 through 19 for this property

advertising.description: Line 5: advertising. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

auto_and_travel.description: Line 6: auto and travel. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

cleaning_and_maintenance.description: Line 7: cleaning and maintenance. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

commissions.description: Line 8: commissions. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

insurance.description: Line 9: insurance. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

legal_and_professional_fees.description: Line 10: legal and other professional fees. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

management_fees.description: Line 11: management fees. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

mortgage_interest.description: Line 12: mortgage interest paid to banks, etc.. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

other_interest.description: Line 13: other interest. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

repairs.description: Line 14: repairs. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

supplies.description: Line 15: supplies. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

taxes.description: Line 16: taxes. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

utilities.description: Line 17: utilities. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

depreciation_or_depletion.description: Line 18: depreciation expense or depletion. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

other_description.description: Line 19: the description written after 'Other (list)', as printed

other_amount.description: Line 19: the amount of other expenses. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

total_expenses.description: Line 20: total expenses for this property. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

income_or_loss.description: Line 21: rents and/or royalties minus total expenses for this property; negative for a loss. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

deductible_rental_loss.description: Line 22: deductible rental real estate loss after limitation, as a positive number. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_23a_total_rents.description: Line 23a: total of all amounts on line 3 for all rental properties. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_23b_total_royalties.description: Line 23b: total of all amounts on line 4 for all royalty properties. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_23c_total_mortgage_interest.description: Line 23c: total of all amounts on line 12 for all properties. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_23d_total_depreciation.description: Line 23d: total of all amounts on line 18 for all properties. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_23e_total_expenses.description: Line 23e: total of all amounts on line 20 for all properties. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_24_income.description: Line 24: income, the sum of positive amounts on line 21. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_25_losses.description: Line 25: total losses, as a positive number. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank

line_26_total_rental_and_royalty_income_.description: Line 26: total rental real estate and royalty income or (loss); negative for a loss. Plain number without commas or the trailing period the form prints; null if the line is blank
